summary: Full regression + new feature testing for BERSINAR POS printer settings modal, product barcode field + wired scanner capture, and image upload with client-side compression. ALL 7 scenarios in the review request passed. Backend already smoke-tested by main agent (barcode field persists via POST/GET /api/products). Admin login works; POS renders 12 seeded products; clicking non-decimal Air Mineral 600ml adds to cart; cash checkout via Tunai + Uang Pas + Proses Pembayaran produces receipt-modal with Rp 42.000; receipt-bt-print-btn click shows 'Printer Bluetooth belum terhubung' toast without crashing. Printer settings modal opens via printer-toggle, shows 'Belum terhubung' status, width-80/width-58 toggle active visual state (emerald-600 class) and persist in localStorage key 'bersinar_printer_width' across modal reopen; printer-test button is disabled while disconnected; printer-connect in headless Chromium (no navigator.bluetooth) shows error toast 'Browser tidak mendukung Bluetooth' with no crash; printer-settings-close closes the modal. Product form: pf-barcode distinct from pf-sku accepts manual entry; pf-scan-barcode captures a synthetic rapid KeyboardEvent stream ('1234567890' + Enter dispatched on window) and auto-fills the pf-barcode field with scanning mode ending (success toast 'Barcode terisi: 1234567890'). Image upload via set_input_files on pf-image-file (hidden) triggers compression -> JPEG data URL preview inside the form, success toast reports KB size ('Gambar dikompres (~1 KB)'), pf-image-size shadcn Select changes between 300/500/800 with role=option (800 selectable), and product saves successfully with the data: image. POS keyboard-emulated scan of the newly created product's barcode auto-adds to cart (cart-total went Rp 0 -> Rp 5.000, one cart-item appeared) WITHOUT any click. Cleanup: TEST_ prefixed products deleted via del-product-{id} buttons.

issues: Several seeded products (Air Mineral, Beras Pandan Wangi, Gula Pasir, Minyak Goreng, Teh Botol) render the same beige/grain stock image because they fall back to the category image (CAT_IMG) when no product image is set. Not a regression from this iteration — but could be mentioned to main agent since seed data looks confusing.

critical_code_review_comments: PrinterSettings.js: Good — gated connect by isSupported() with user-friendly toast, test button properly disabled on !connected, width persisted to localStorage inside setWidth and read in state init. localStorage key naming is consistent ('bersinar_printer_width', 'bersinar_printer_id').

printer.js tryReconnect() correctly guards on navigator.bluetooth.getDevices availability (newer API), returns false silently on headless/incompatible browsers. Chunked writes (180B) with 25ms sleep is reasonable for cheap BLE thermal printers.

Products.js ProductForm scan listener: uses window keydown with capture=true, gap>80ms resets buffer, caps buffer at 64 chars (fixes the unbounded-growth concern from iteration_3), 15s timeout to auto-exit scanning. e.preventDefault() keeps keystrokes out of form inputs during scan.

image.js compressImage(): Correct canvas-based resize preserving aspect ratio, JPEG quality 0.72 default, fills white background before draw (prevents transparent-PNG black bands). Produces data: URL stored in image_url — note: large data URLs will bloat the Product document; 500px/0.72 is a sensible default.
POS.js handleScan: matches sku OR barcode (case-insensitive exact) — verified a product with only 'barcode' set is auto-added via keyboard scan.
Minor: compressImage does not revoke/cleanup FileReader on error unmount, but it's a short-lived promise so no real leak.

Minor: ProductForm scan listener attaches on window with capture — fine, but if a user clicks pf-scan-barcode and then types in another input before the scanner fires, each keystroke is preventDefault'd. The 15s timeout mitigates this. Consider showing a dismiss button next to 'Scan...' state.

success_rate.backend: N/A (not retested; smoke-tested by main agent)

seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up 3 TEST_ prefixed products during the test: TEST_Prod_<ts> (barcode persistence), TEST_Img_<ts> (image upload). TEST_Scan_<ts> was never saved — scan form was closed. Final product count returned to seeded baseline (12).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login redirects to '/' not '/pos' — explicitly navigate to /pos after login. POS checkout flow: click product-card -> checkout-btn (text 'Bayar') -> payment modal shows pay-Cash/pay-QRIS/pay-Bank/pay-Credit buttons -> must click 'Uang Pas' quick button to fill Uang Diterima -> checkout-confirm button 'Proses Pembayaran' -> receipt-modal appears with receipt-bt-print-btn. Product cards use data-testid='product-{id}' (NOT 'product-card-{id}'). Scan simulation technique that works: page.evaluate(code => { for(ch of code) window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:ch,bubbles:true})); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); }). Web Bluetooth is not available in automation browser — only error toast paths can be exercised for printer-connect/test-print.
